mentions.name: Flashframe
mentions.description: This is a fast-paced, multiplayer daily movie frame guessing game where players guess movies from frames. Built with HTML, Node, and PostgreSQL and leveraging the TMDB API, it adds timed multiplayer rounds to the movie-guessing game format.
mentions.problem: Existing daily movie frame guessing games are neither multiplayer nor timed.
mentions.audience: People who enjoy daily movie frame guessing games
mentions.source_excerpt: For fun (and learning) Claude Code and I created a fast-paced, multiplayer movie guessing game over the past few weeks, HTML, Node, and PostgresSQL, leveraging the TMDB API.
